g.inkscape:label: Contours (elevation, toggle layer)
g.desc: Contours derived from the Canadian Digital Elevation Model (CDEM), Natural Resources Canada, resampled to a 157 m grid, lightly smoothed, contoured every 400 m and simplified. Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Canada (https://open.canada.ca/en/open-government-licence-canada). Basin outline: BC Freshwater Atlas assessment watersheds, Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Interval 400 m. Same map-to-poster transform as the river layer.
